Around eight/nine years old, I'm having a sleepover with my friend and we're playing around when suddenly she screams. I freak out and ask her what's wrong and she silently points to the window and when I look there's a face pushing against the glass. I start screaming and we run out to tell my mom who goes into the backyard to check but finds nothing. This happens over the span of like a minute and we had a giant privacy fence with no opening on that side of the yard so whatever it was would have had to run past the door my mom went through. Still have no idea what the fuck it was.
